display_name: Four Acts, one ontology — a cleanroom re-encoding of Singapore's death-in-the-family statutes
scope: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT encoding of this subject, written without reading the `legalese` encoding beside it, so that the two can be compared as evidence rather than as one thing checked against itself. It adds a fourth Act the first does not carry: the Guardianship of Infants Act 1934. The Wills Act 1838, Intestate Succession Act 1967 and Probate and Administration Act 1934 are re-encoded from the source PDFs. Law stated as at 26 August 2026; NO rule-version axis and zero dated arms, so it cannot answer about an earlier version. 1,907 scenario assertions, none failing. NOT REVIEWED: the pipeline run behind report/ carries HG1 WAIVED, not granted -- no human has read this against the Acts section by section. Open questions are in registers/fork-register.json (62 forks) and in NOTES.md.

not_reviewed.note: The waiver text is in report/go-run-report.md's Gates section and on report/go-run-journal.ndjson.
